// Fixed types for task (e). Do not edit; check.sh uses its own copy.
import type { ReadonlyStore } from "@get-modular/observation";

/** The audit module's own slice of the settings. */
export type AuditSettings = { readonly retentionDays: number };
export type AuditDeps = { readonly settings: ReadonlyStore<AuditSettings> };

/** An existing adapter. An open log holds a storage connection until `close` resolves. */
export type AuditLog = {
  readonly setRetention: (days: number) => void;
  readonly append: (entry: string) => void;
  readonly close: () => Promise<void>;
};
/** Opening connects to storage and takes a while. Honors `signal`: rejects with an AbortError once it is aborted. */
export declare function openAuditLog(retentionDays: number, options: { readonly signal: AbortSignal }): Promise<AuditLog>;

export type AuditPort = { readonly record: (entry: string) => undefined };
export type AuditProduct = { readonly instance: AuditLog; readonly capabilities: { readonly "acme/audit": AuditPort } };
